title: A goal removed with money in it: the money waits "to place" and stays out of safe to spend (final_review_1 S7, decision P1)
story: One bank, set up Mon 4 Jan 2027 with 150,000, of which 100,000 is kept for a trip. An emergency place starts empty. No fixed pay and no Free to spend amount, so nothing caps the headline. On Wed 6 Jan the person removes the trip: its 100,000 moves to Waiting marked "to place". On Thu 7 Jan they place 30,000 of it in the emergency place; on Fri 8 Jan they set aside another 20,000 for emergencies from the bank's other money. Every amount is made up.

events.note: placed from the trip's money waiting to place
from the bank's other money in Waiting

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 150,000 (Bank today) - 100,000 (the trip's money, moved to Waiting and marked to place) = 50,000
asks.note: Before P1 the 100,000 went into the headroom and the headline jumped to 150,000 (final_review_1 S7).

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 150,000 (Bank today) - 30,000 (Emergency, kept in it) - 70,000 (the trip's money still to place: 100,000 - 30,000 placed) = 50,000
asks.note: Placing money that was to place moves it, it does not free it: the headline is unchanged.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 150,000 (Bank today) - 50,000 (Emergency, kept in it: 30,000 + 20,000) - 70,000 (the trip's money still to place) = 30,000
asks.note: The 20,000 came from the bank's other money, not from the money to place, so 70,000 is still to place.
